amendment_reason: The current Codex App can return only provisional visible-task identity through the public creation surface and can delay public task and archive indexing. v0.7.6 predates the exact private ready-identity and archive-evidence contracts required to distinguish those host behaviors from routing outcomes. The frozen comparison therefore uses the current accepted v0.7.8 authority without changing its experimental design.

json_pointer_overrides.previous: After a fresh v0.7.6 authority check, run only the two scheduled blind cases and their three frozen arms with no new telemetry or routing behavior.
json_pointer_overrides.replacement: After a fresh v0.7.8 authority check, run only the two scheduled blind cases and their three frozen arms with no new telemetry or routing behavior.

json_pointer_overrides.previous: One fresh Sol-high coordinator uses exactly two Terra-high user-visible tasks according to the case-specific DAG and ownership, then integrates and verifies serially through v0.7.6.
json_pointer_overrides.replacement: One fresh Sol-high coordinator uses exactly two Terra-high user-visible tasks according to the case-specific DAG and ownership, then integrates and verifies serially through v0.7.8.

json_pointer_overrides.previous: Stop before launch if the fresh v0.7.6 authority check fails, any required selector is unsupported, a source archive digest differs, the imported baseline is dirty, or visible-task authorization is absent.
json_pointer_overrides.replacement: Stop before launch if the fresh v0.7.8 authority check fails, any required selector is unsupported, a source archive digest differs, the imported baseline is dirty, or visible-task authorization is absent.

frozen_without_change: zero selector replans, fallbacks, and retries

interpretation: This addendum makes the frozen retrospective comparison executable on the current accepted host contract. A package or host compatibility failure remains a stopping condition and is not evidence for or against a routing arm. No evaluation arm has run and no result was examined while creating this addendum.
